                            GetId=lambda: 78 if kind == 'other-id' else 77,
                            GetWindow=get_window)

                  EventFilter=SimpleNamespace(Event_Skip=-1)))
    assert env['observe_destroy'](event) == -1, 'Observation must preserve normal native dispatch.'
